As an IT Specialist (System Analysis) "Product Manager", GS-2210-14, you will be responsible for: Leading the development of FSA products by understanding the needs of students, families, and stakeholders, translating insights into product roadmaps, prioritizing high-impact features, and measuring success by user outcomes.

Serving as the bridge between policy goals, technical systems, and user needs by translating complex constraints into actionable requirements and ensuring compliant, secure, and user-friendly solutions at national scale.

Collaborating and aligning with contractors, partner agencies, and cross-functional teams to align efforts with the product vision, hold vendors accountable for outcomes, and deliver tangible improvements for users.

Fostering a product culture of experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement while providing vision and expert recommendations that align government staff and vendors around shared goals for students and families.

Applying deep experience building and managing products at scale to ensure FSA systems deliver accurate, secure, reliable, and seamless experiences while protecting sensitive personal and financial data.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-14, if you possess the specialize experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-14: One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-13 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: Experience serving as the product expert in the development of a scaled technology platform.

Experience serving as a product manager, overseeing internal and external software development, testing, integration, and operation. Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translating business requirements into technical user stories.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement).

Knowledge of product management principles, with a focus on user-centered design and measurable outcomes. Skill in translating policy and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable product solutions. Skill in managing vendors and cross-functional teams to deliver results and drive tangible product improvements.

Ability to inspire and sustain a mission-driven product culture and drive collaborative efforts amongst the teams. Knowledge of building and operating large-scale, mission-critical systems or comparable technology infrastructure.

Was haben ein Top-Mountainbike, ein künstliches Hüftgelenk und ein Smartphone gemeinsam? Wir entwickeln die Software, um diese High-End-Produkte herzustellen! Mit hyperMILL® steuern wir CNC-Maschinen und haben höchste Ansprüche an Leistung und Teilequalität.
Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Entwickler von leistungsstarken CAD/CAM-Lösungen – und das seit mehr als 30 Jahren! Unsere innovativen CAD/CAM-Technologien sorgen für eine deutlich höhere Performance im Programmierprozess und setzen internationale Maßstäbe in der zerspanenden Fertigung.
Für unser Produktmanagement suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Produktmanager (m/w/d) mit starkem Verständnis für zerspanende Prozesse und der 2.5D, 3-Achs und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung.
Ihre Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte
Identifikation, Priorisierung und Validierung von Kundenanforderungen, Marktpotenzialen und technologischen Chancen im Bereich 2.5D-, 3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung
Begleitung der Produktentwicklung von der Problemdefinition und Discovery über die Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung neuer Funktionen und Lösungen
Bewertung von Anforderungen hinsichtlich Kundennutzen, technischer Machbarkeit und strategischer Relevanz sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Produktstrategie
Absicherung neuer Konzepte und Lösungen durch Kundenfeedback, Praxistests sowie strukturierte Risikoanalysen
Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, QA, Anwendungstechnik, Support, Marketing und Vertrieb zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten und erfolgreichen Produktentwicklung

Sicherstellung der konsistenten Integration neuer Funktionen in Bezug auf User Experience, Produktstrategie und hyperMILL-Gesamtkonzept sowie Verantwortung für die Erreichung definierter Produktziele und die nachhaltige Verbesserung des Kundennutzens
Ihr Profil
Tiefgreifendes Wissen in der Zerspanung sowie fundiertes Verständnis von CAM-Prozessen, CNC-Maschinen, Steuerungen, Werkzeugen und Fertigungsabläufen
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im CAM-, Zerspanungs- oder Produktmanagementumfeld sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Validierung und Markteinführung technischer Produktlösungen
Souveräne Bewertung von Anforderungen, Risiken und Prioritäten sowie Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Aufbereitung komplexer technischer Sachverhalte
Sicheres Agieren im Austausch mit Kunden sowie interdisziplinären Teams und Stakeholdern

**
📍 Standort: Berlin (hybrid)
🕓 Start: Ab sofort | Vollzeit | unbefristet
Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Lösung für die Immobilienverwaltung (App & Plattform) in Deutschland. Du setzt die richtigen Prioritäten, arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams in Deutschland und Paris zusammen und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für den deutschen Markt.
Aufgaben

Du entwickelst die Produktvision und -strategie für Deutschland auf Basis von Daten, Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen
Du priorisierst und verantwortest die Produkt-Roadmap in enger Abstimmung mit den deutschen Teams
Du setzt Roadmap-Themen gemeinsam mit Tech, Design, GenAI und Operations um
Du erstellst und pflegst PRDs mit klarer Begründung, Kontext und KPI-Zielen
Du koordinierst Releases, Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen
Du misst den Produkterfolg, kommunizierst Ergebnisse und leitest Optimierungen ab

s.h: Must Have : Du sprichst Deutsch und Französisch auf C2 Niveau.
s.t:
Du lebst in Berlin und arbeitest gerne regelmäßig im Büro mit den Teams
Du hast 1–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, idealerweise im Start-up-Umfeld
Du nutzt KI selbstverständlich in Deinem PM-Alltag für Analyse, Automatisierung und Prototyping
Du fühlst Dich in einem schnellen, dynamischen Umfeld wohl und treibst Themen eigenständig voran
Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst klar und kollaborierst teamübergreifend
Bei Matera garantieren wir Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Hier bist du so willkommen, wie du bist!

Vergütung: 55.000–75.000 € brutto pro Jahr , abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung.
Matera Benefits wie vergünstigte Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Lunch-Gutscheine + monatlicher ÖPNV-Zuschuss
Einen großen Verantwortungsbereich und echte Gestaltungsfreiheit ab dem ersten Tag: Du bist der Product Manager für das deutsche Produkt und hast maßgeblichen Einfluss auf dessen Entwicklung.
Ein Umfeld, in dem Du schnell lernst: Ein erfahrenes französisches Product-Team unterstützt Dich, gleichzeitig arbeitest Du direkt mit dem Country Manager und den operativen Teams zusammen.
Ein profitables, stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer klaren europäischen Vision.
Ein Büro in Berlin mit mindestens drei Präsenztagen pro Woche sowie gelegentlichen Reisen nach Paris, um Zeit mit dem Product- und Tech-Team zu verbringen.
Ein ambitioniertes Team mit starkem Zusammenhalt und Spaß an der Arbeit 🙂

Unsere Mission bei Matera ist es, Wohnungseigentümer*innen glücklich zu machen! Durch uns können sie ihre Immobilie transparent und einfach selbst verwalten, oder die Verwaltung ganzheitlich in unsere Hände legen und dadurch eine Menge Zeit und Geld sparen.

Um unser Team kennenzulernen und Eindrücke von unserer Kultur zu bekommen, schaue gerne bei uns auf LinkedIn oder auf Instagram vorbei!

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta ’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel.

The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia.

Cresta ’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day.

Come build that future at Cresta . About the Role As our first EMEA Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent , you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers.

This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally.

You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution. In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make each AI Agent successful.

You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform. As the first hire in EMEA, you’ll also play a key role in setting the standards for the role in the EMEA region and helping to grow the team as we scale.

What You’ll Do Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value!

To do this, you’ll… Own the deployment lifecycle for AI Agents — from scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents in partnership with FDEs using Cresta ’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI Serve as the AI Agent SME for the EMEA Sales cycle, partnering on demos, solutioning, and deal reviews to ensure technical feasibility, value articulation, and successful handoff to deployment.

Lead customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.

Facilitate workshops and design sessions with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria Work closely with FDEs to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment Build our forward deployed practice for EMEA, setting the standards for future growth What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product, or Customer Success roles, ideally working closely with AI or LLM first products Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action.

You anticipate needs and bottlenecks and deliver with urgency and care.

Experience leading complex deployments, owning customer relationships (including senior customer stakeholders), and working cross-functionally Strong technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!) Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment Passion for AI, automation, and shaping the future of customer experience Bonus Points Background in product management, conversation design or forward deployed engineering roles Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced 20 days of vacation time Compensation at Cresta Cresta ’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people.

We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain.

Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai Originally posted on Himalayas

At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking an Senior Product Manager specialist to join one of our clients ' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
Tasks
As a Senior Product Manager you will be responsible for the success of client’s product from start to finish. Specifically, this means:
-Strategy & Roadmap: You develop a clear vision, translate company goals into tangible product objectives, and maintain a prioritized roadmap.
-Backlog & Planning: You write clear user stories, ensure the backlog remains organized, and make sure everything aligns with sprint and quarterly goals.
-Discovery & Validation: You conduct structured discovery, evaluate ideas and solutions, and derive decisions from them.
-Delivery & Quality: You work closely with Engineering and QA to ensure features are launched on time and with high quality – including test cases and release notes.
-Metrics & Impact: You define success criteria, track usage and performance, and optimize them based on measurable results.
-Stakeholder Alignment: You communicate priorities, compromises, and progress clearly and transparently to Business, Operations, and Leadership.
-User Focus: You incorporate the user's voice into all decisions.
-Leadership & Collaboration: You ensure close collaboration between developers, QA, design, and business stakeholders so everyone knows what matters and who is responsible for what.
-Platform Team: You shape client’s platform and process topics—from custom workflows and task management to notifications and permissions—and ensure they are specifically tailored to the requirements of insurers and MGAs.

Experience: At least 8 years of professional experience in product management. Ideally in the insurance, finance, or workflow sectors (e.g., Camunda, Celonis, n8n, etc.).
End-to-End Product Ownership: Proven experience managing the product lifecycle from discovery to market launch and in continuous improvement through data-driven methods.
Agile Methods: Solid knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and requirements engineering.
Analytical Skills: Ability to translate complex business and technical problems into clear, actionable requirements.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German (C1 level).
Tools: Practical experience with common project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Figma, analytics tools, API documentation platforms).
Problem Solving: You thrive in complex situations, consciously and thoughtfully compromise, and drive coordination, keeping stakeholders informed as needed.
Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with engineering, QA, design, and operations teams to deliver value incrementally and iteratively.

StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.
The Creatives team is on a mission to build a one-stop-shop for advertisers' creative production and management needs.

We're developing a comprehensive in-house product that lets clients create, enhance, preview, store, and manage CTV, video, audio, DOOH, display, and native ads at scale — whether they start from ready-made templates or build from scratch.

By delivering a robust, full-featured in-house solution, we reduce our clients' reliance on costly third-party creative providers and empower advertisers to move faster and more efficiently.
The next chapter for the team centers on AI-powered content generation and a multi-channel creative experience, with particular focus on AI first video and CTV solutions. It's a high-impact, fast-moving area with significant room to define the product, the technology, and the creative workflows that will set the standard for how advertisers build at scale.
As a Senior Product Manager on the Creatives team, you'll own a portfolio at the heart of this ambition. This is a 0→1 space that spans multiple teams and disciplines, and you'll set the direction for it: shaping strategy, making the hard calls, and shipping. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue to translate a bold vision into products advertisers love.
StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to candidates in Canada and the United States.
What You'll Be Doing
Own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for a portfolio spanning the video/CTV creative builder, AI-generated and brand content products, and creative integrations with social and partner platforms.
Lead 0→1 initiatives from first principles — research and validate the problem, frame the opportunity, define the path forward, and drive it to launch and adoption.
Translate complex, cross-team problems into a clear vision and crisp, actionable requirements that give Engineering, Design, and QE unambiguous direction on how features should behave.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to shape how AI/ML and generative content capabilities are applied across creative formats, making sound technical trade-offs along the way.
Define key success metrics, monitor KPIs, and make data-informed decisions about what to build, what to cut, and what to double down on.
Work hand-in-hand with Creative Studio to ensure the tooling reflects real creative workflows and produces work that meets a high creative and brand bar.
Build new integrations with external platforms, partnering across teams to open up a wider range of creative assets and ad formats within the creative library.
Communicate precisely and proactively across the organization, keeping stakeholders aligned and informed at the right level and the right time.
Support customer-facing teams by resolving questions about your portfolio and helping triage bugs and regressions as they appear.

s.h: What You'll Bring to the Table
s.t:
Proven experience as a Product Manager at a technology company, with a track record of shipping large, complex software products end-to-end (and you can speak to your successes).
Demonstrated success leading 0→1 initiatives that span multiple teams — you bring structure and direction to new problem spaces and rally others around a clear plan.
Experience building products in AdTech, MarTech, or creative platforms, with a meaningful edge for those who've worked on creative-building or generative AI products.
Strong fluency with AI/ML and generative AI concepts — enough to partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering, reason about capabilities and limitations, and make informed product decisions.
A technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience) that lets you discuss technical trade-offs, integrations, and architecture credibly with engineers.
A keen design and creative sense, balanced with technical depth — you pair an eye for what "great" looks like with the ability to partner closely with engineering on how to build it.
An excellent cross-functional collaborator who can tailor your approach across Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue without skipping a beat.
Clear, structured writing and communication — you distill complex ideas into words that build consensus and align stakeholders around your vision.
Strong prioritization instincts grounded in reason, clarity, and purpose — you focus the team on the most impactful work and the KPIs you're moving.
A leadership style rooted in influence rather than formal authority, and the judgment to operate independently in a fast-moving, evolving space.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large.

This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives , influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders.

By combining expertise in complia nce requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation.

1. Product Management

· Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products.

· Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes.

· Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything.

2. Customer-facing communications

· Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status.

· In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO.

· Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements.

3. Competitive analysis and market research

· Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications.

· Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market.

· Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards).

4. Certification and audit support, service ownership

· Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements.

· Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform.

· Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives.

5. Cross-functional collaboration

· Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging.

· Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports).

· Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally.

· 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives.

· Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value.

· Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences).

· Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams.

· Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions.

· Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals.

s.h: It will be an added bonus if you have
s.t:
· Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware.

This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

· Competitive compensation

· Career growth and learning opportunities

· Flexibility and ownership

· Collaborative and innovative culture

· Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

· International environment and talented teams

You will own the roadmap for a core part of Diligent’s governance, risk and compliance SaaS platform, shaping how senior leaders and boards collaborate, communicate and make decisions in a secure, modern way. You’ll turn customer problems and market insights into simple, impactful product experiences, and work closely with engineering, design, and go ‑ to ‑ market teams to bring them to life.

In this Senior Product Manager role, you’ll spend your time deeply understanding customer needs, prioritising what truly moves the needle, and defining clear success metrics for everything you ship. You’ll lead a cross ‑ functional squad, manage the product backlog, and launch features that drive engagement, adoption and measurable outcomes for our customers across the Diligent Platform.

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)

· Own and continuously refine the product roadmap for your area, using customer insight, data and market trends to prioritise what to build next.

· Define and drive product strategy that aligns with Diligent’s vision for modern governance, connecting your roadmap to clear business and customer outcomes.

· Act as the voice of the customer: run discovery, validate problems and solutions, and translate insights into clear user stories and product requirements.

· Lead an agile, cross ‑ functional team (engineering, UX, product marketing, sales, customer success) to design, build and launch high ‑ quality SaaS features.

· Set goals, KPIs and success metrics for your product, track performance and user engagement, and iterate based on what the data and customers tell you.

· Tackle complex product and execution challenges by breaking down ambiguous problems, navigating trade ‑ offs, and making clear, data ‑ informed decisions.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview

· Solid experience as a Product Manager building, shipping, and iterating B2B Enterprise SaaS products and AI assistants and Agents, with a proven track record of defining and launching successful features or products.

· Strong hands ‑ on experience working in agile, cross ‑ functional product teams, including backlog management and writing user stories.

· Comfortable leading customer discovery and validation conversations and turning qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.

· Proven ability to influence and align cross ‑ functional partners and senior stakeholders without formal authority.

· Data ‑ driven mindset: confident with metrics, experimentation and basic quantitative reasoning to set goals, measure impact and debug product issues.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply to both technical and non ‑ technical audiences.

· A bias for action and ownership: you’re happy to roll up your sleeves, make trade ‑ offs and drive a project from problem definition through to launch and iteration.

It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t

· Experience in governance, risk, compliance, security, fintech or other B2B enterprise domains.

· Exposure to large ‑ scale, multi ‑ product platforms or secure communication/collaboration tools.

· Experience mentoring other product managers or playing a “bar ‑ raiser” role in product quality and decision ‑ making.

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

You will ensure a coherent platform experience across product lines by critically reviewing roadmap scope, sequencing, and cross-product touch points for tenant-facing offerings and by actively preventing fragmentation and UX drift at platform level.
You will provide strategic oversight and governance for customer-facing releases by reviewing and signing off on product strategy, functional scope, and platform alignment across all releases within your area of responsibility.
You will actively surface, resolve, and de-risk cross-product dependencies by identifying unknowns early, unblocking teams, and ensuring consistent platform behavior and correct sequencing across planning and delivery. You will do this while progressively shifting the role from execution-driven coordination toward strategic platform stewardship .
You will drive new business by identifying, engaging, and winning new clients while building long-term customer relationships that support ARISE's continued growth.

Community and team spirit: You’ll work with a team that is more than just colleagues – we are a community that supports, challenges, and inspires each other.

The Opportunity
As Product Manager - Merchant Experience, you will own the discovery, definition, and delivery of Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal: the place where merchants see their transactions and payouts, understand their fees, pull reports, and manage their account.

It is the everyday face of Xplor 's payments platform, and your job is to make it clear, trustworthy, and genuinely useful across global markets. This portal also acts as the internal platform our own teams use to support and configure those merchants.
You will sit at the intersection of product craft, payments, and data - turning information owned by the billing, payout, and financials teams into an experience that answers a merchant's most important questions at a glance: have I been paid, what did it cost me, and is my account set up the way I need? You will partner closely with design and research, and with the upstream teams whose data you surface.

Merchant Portal Strategy & Roadmap
Own and evolve the strategy and roadmap for Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal across global markets.
Define a vision for a merchant experience that is clear, trustworthy, and reduces the need to contact support.
Prioritise ruthlessly against merchant impact, adoption, and support deflection, and present priorities to the VP of Product.
Align your roadmap with the billing, payout, and financials teams whose data the portal surfaces.
Transactions, Payouts & Reporting
Own the surfaces where merchants view transactions and payouts.
Define clear, accurate reporting and statements that merchants can pull themselves, without raising a ticket.
Make fees and deductions transparent, so merchants understand their cost of payments.
Ensure the money shown to merchants is accurate and reconciled with the underlying platform data.
Account Management & Self-Serve
Own merchant self-service: managing account details, users and permissions, and settings without contacting support.
Identify the highest-volume support reasons that the portal should be able to deflect, and design self-serve flows to remove them.
Build in-product help and guidance that meets merchants where they are.
Track and reduce support contact rates for portal-addressable issues as a core metric.
Merchant Configuration & Enablement
Own the configuration portal the BMS team uses to set up and maintain merchants: pricing, fees, product configuration, and account settings.
Own and drive the capabilities of our configuration portal to remove work out of engineering and into the hands of the team closest to the merchant, with the guardrails that money-affecting changes require.
Define validation, approvals, and change history for pricing and fee changes, so a mistake is hard to make and easy to trace.
Work with the billing, payout, and financials teams to make sure configuration set internally is reflected accurately in what the merchant sees and is charged.
Experience, Craft & Adoption
Partner closely with design and engineering to ship intuitive, well-crafted experiences grounded in real merchant needs.
Run discovery with merchants to understand their jobs-to-be-done and validate solutions before building.
Use product analytics to understand behaviour, find friction, and measure the impact of what you ship.

Develop strategies to serve diverse user profiles — from advanced traders to speculative and novice traders — adapting the product to their distinct preferences and requirements.

Partner with Engineering to ensure efficient feature implementation, maintaining a balance between innovation and operational feasibility.
Measure the impact of product initiatives through well-defined metrics, using data-driven insights to refine strategies and deliver measurable outcomes.

5+ years of product management experience with a demonstrated track record in consumer-facing product, ideally in trading, fintech, or crypto.
Solid understanding of manual trading workflows across mobile and web — including the needs and behaviors of different trader personas.
Strong ability to translate user research and local market insights into actionable product roadmaps.
Excellent product sense, attention to detail, and a history of shipping products that users love.
Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data to prioritize, validate hypotheses, and measure outcomes.
Proven cross-functional leadership — able to align design, engineering, data, and commercial teams around a shared vision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly to diverse stakeholders.

Direct experience in the Latin American market — understanding of local user behaviors, payment ecosystems, regulatory environments, and cultural nuances across the region.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.
The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.
What you'll work on
Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain
Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.
Our humble expectations
We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.
You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.
Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

About Teramind
Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.
The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end.

You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role.

The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology.

AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability.

Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.
What You Will Own
The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control . Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local models running offline - and capturing the prompts, pastes, uploads, and agent-executed commands that browser and network DLP cannot see.
Translating business vision into engineering reality . You turn signals from executives, sales, customers, competitors and the engineering org into a coherent technical roadmap. You are the interpreter between “we need to detect AI exfiltration” and “here is how we instrument the endpoint to see it.”
Building for the enterprise: bulletproof and undetectable . Enterprise customers expect the Agent to be invisible to end users, resilient against tampering, and reliable in conditions that break weaker products. You own the roadmap that keeps it that way.
Performance, footprint, and reliability. Every CPU cycle, megabyte and battery percent we consume is felt by the end user and argued about by the customer's IT team. You set and defend the performance bar.
Define, measure, and meet product KPIs. Adoption, rollout velocity, deployment success rate, crash rates, detection coverage, time-to-patch on OS changes. You set the numbers and hold the team and the company to them.
Industry and ecosystem relationships. Microsoft, Apple, the Linux ecosystem, MDM vendors, and the major AV and EDR vendors. You represent Teramind in technical conversations where the agent's architecture is the subject.

Du kennst Shopify nicht nur aus der täglichen Shop-Pflege, sondern weißt auch, wie man einen Shop von Grund auf aufbaut und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt?
Dann werde Teil unseres E-Commerce-Teams bei Holz-Richter! Als Shopify E-Commerce Manager / Product Owner (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung neuer Shopify-Shops für casando. Dabei bekommst du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, deine Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben.
Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen E-Commerce, UX und Technik und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Shopify-Shops sowohl aus Kundensicht als auch technisch überzeugen.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst als Product Owner die Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Shopify-Shops.
Du setzt neue Shops möglichst eigenständig auf und entwickelst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter.
Du konzipierst und optimierst Shop-Strukturen, Navigation, Landingpages und Customer Journeys mit Blick auf eine gute User Experience und Conversion.
Du konfigurierst Shopify, Themes und Apps und entscheidest, welche Lösungen für den jeweiligen Shop sinnvoll sind.
Du setzt Anpassungen im Shop eigenständig um und koordinierst bei Bedarf technische Anforderungen.
Du kümmerst dich um die Anbindung und das Zusammenspiel von Shopify mit weiteren Systemen, Schnittstellen und Middleware-Lösungen.
Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt neue Features, Tests und Verbesserungen eigenverantwortlich um.
Du behältst aktuelle Shopify-Entwicklungen, neue Funktionen, Apps und E-Commerce-Trends im Blick und prüfst, welche davon für unsere Shops relevant sind.
Qualifikation
Du hast fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Shopify und hast idealerweise bereits selbstständig Shopify-Shops aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt.
Du verstehst Shopify nicht nur aus Anwendersicht, sondern bringst auch das notwendige technische Verständnis mit, um viele Anforderungen eigenständig umzusetzen.
Du kennst dich mit Shopify Themes, Apps und Schnittstellen aus; Kenntnisse im Bereich Middleware sind von Vorteil.
Idealerweise kannst du auch Anpassungen an Shopify-Themes selbst vornehmen. Kenntnisse in Liquid , der Shopify-eigenen Template-Sprache, sowie in HTML, CSS und JavaScript sind ein Plus.
Du kannst damit kleinere technische und gestalterische Änderungen möglichst eigenständig umsetzen, ohne für jede Anpassung auf Entwicklungsressourcen angewiesen zu sein.
Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für E-Commerce, UX und Conversion-Optimierung mit und kannst technische und fachliche Anforderungen miteinander verbinden.
Du arbeitest sehr selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Du hast Lust, neue Shops von Beginn an mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Entscheidungen aktiv voranzutreiben.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
